baseline_models.focus_anchor: The witness's conditional joins the shirt, its longitudinal tear, its front orientation, and the opposed truth labels.
baseline_models.mechanism: A worn covering becomes a trace surface: the direction of its damage mediates between incompatible spoken accounts.

activation_trace.role: The mark-as-witness branch lets a visible trace carry testimony beyond the human speaker.
The worn covering supplies the physical surface attached to the body and its movement.
The longitudinal slit makes the damage directional rather than generic.
Front-facing orientation supplies the spatial variable tested by the conditional.
Truth of speech is the positive verdict assigned when the material condition holds.
Contradiction of truth supplies the opposed verdict, making the test discriminative.

changed_reading.before: A witness verbally decides which claimant is truthful.
changed_reading.after: The witness proposes a material cross-examination in which the garment's oriented damage is made to testify.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The clause begins with a condition about whether the shirt is torn from the front before assigning truth and falsehood.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah suspends judgment inside a possible state of affairs; truth status is downstream of an inspectable spatial condition, not of rank or first accusation.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence in a state or time frames the proposed tear pattern as a condition to be established.
Knowledge-based clarification makes testimony a reasoned test rather than an unsupported preference.
Priority and forward orientation keep open one hypothesized ordering of the encounter.
Her truth is explicitly conditional rather than presumed.
Attribution of lying is likewise produced by the test instead of attached to him in advance.

changed_reading.before: Yusuf's denial simply counters her accusation with another assertion.
changed_reading.after: The ayah interrupts assertion with a falsifiable hypothesis, temporarily withholding the social labels of truthful and liar.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yusuf says that she solicited him away from or concerning his own self, while clarification comes from one of her own people.
baseline_models.mechanism: A struggle over another's will is answered by first-person self-assertion, then tested by a voice arising inside the accuser's affiliation.

activation_trace.role: Audible speech lets Yusuf reclaim grammatical agency by naming her as the acting party.
Solicitation as a contest of wills makes the dispute concern pressure on another's chosen action.
The thing-itself branch anchors the pressure in Yusuf's own person rather than an abstract temptation.
The inner awareness branch opens an autonomy reading in which his inward judgment is under pressure.
Near affiliation makes the corrective witness socially internal to her side.

changed_reading.before: He reports an attempted seduction, and a convenient witness happens to be present.
changed_reading.after: He asserts self-command against an attempt to redirect his will, and her own affiliation generates an internal check on her account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier chain of concealment, commodification, undervalued exchange, purchase, and proposed adoption gives the focus phrase about his own self a history of other people assigning uses and identities to him.

activation_trace.role: His own person is the focus anchor against which prior acts of appropriation are reread.
Concealment places Yusuf inside a hidden transaction before he can speak for himself.
A tradable portion converts the concealed person into merchandise.
Exchange supplies the explicit transfer through which others dispose of him.
Diminution of due worth intensifies the reduction of a person to an undervalued object.
Taking or acquiring as a son assigns a new household identity from outside.

structural_cues: 12:19-12:21 orders the sequence as concealment, merchandise, sale, purchase, and possible adoption before the focus dispute.
The focus is the first line in this window where Yusuf's first-person speech explicitly centers his own self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated external disposal of Yusuf; I infer that 'my self' can reassert self-possession against that history. A live alternative is that the earlier chain is narrative background and the phrase remains only the ordinary idiom of solicitation.

changed_reading.before: The phrase describes only the immediate object of sexual solicitation.
changed_reading.after: Without losing that sense, it can also mark Yusuf's reassertion of personhood after a sequence in which others hid, priced, transferred, and reassigned him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Closed access, direct summons, active self-protection, command, and threatened confinement turn the focus solicitation into a pressure system backed by control of space and punishment.

activation_trace.role: The contest-of-wills branch anchors the focus verb in pressure directed at another's action.
Inner judgment supplies the self-governing capacity that the pressure seeks to displace.
Coercive narrowing turns the setting into controlled enclosure rather than neutral privacy.
The controlled entrance makes exit and access part of the struggle.
The direct summons supplies an overt attempt to call him into the desired act.
Protective holding names his resistance as active preservation, not mere lack of interest.
Obligating command exposes authority behind the solicitation.
Threatened confinement supplies the penalty for preserving his refusal.
Humiliation shows that submission of status, not only erotic consent, is at stake.

structural_cues: 12:23 places solicitation after emphatic door-closing and before Yusuf seeks refuge.
12:32 repeats the solicitation, states that he protected himself, then couples an order with prison and humiliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, summons, resistance, command, and punishment; I infer a causal escalation from persuasion to coercion aimed at self-command. A live alternative is that erotic solicitation and institutional threat are successive but semantically separate stages.

changed_reading.before: She tried to persuade him into a private sexual act.
changed_reading.after: Her solicitation is also a coercive attempt to control his body and will through space, rank, command, and threatened punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The front-facing hypothesis is completed by a race toward an exit and an actual tear from behind, so the shirt records relative position and direction of travel.

activation_trace.role: A physical mark can testify once motion gives its location causal meaning.
The elongated tear can retain a directional trace of force.
The front supplies one side of the spatial discrimination.
Competitive forward movement supplies the encounter's kinematics.
The entrance functions as the destination of escape and the place where the parties are encountered.
The narrated tearing event links the later test to an actual directed force.
The back locates her force behind the moving wearer.
The complementary rear condition converts the focus's one-sided hypothesis into a two-way test.

structural_cues: 12:25 orders racing toward the door before she tears his shirt from behind.
12:26-12:27 mirror front and rear conditions while swapping the truth and lie assignments.
12:28 reports inspection of the shirt torn from behind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the race, destination, her act of tearing from behind, mirrored conditions, and inspection; I infer that the damage reconstructs Yusuf ahead and moving away while she follows and pulls. The geometry establishes relative motion more securely than it establishes every motive.

changed_reading.before: The shirt is a static object bearing an incriminating or exculpatory tear.
changed_reading.after: The shirt is a trajectory record from which relative position, pursuit, and attempted escape can be abductively reconstructed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The household's truth test enters city speech, where an external audience supplies an interior motive, the woman hears the circulating account, and her later admission returns to the focus verb.

activation_trace.role: The branch of speech circulating among people opens a public afterlife for Yusuf's claim.
The city women's saying realizes the movement from household utterance to shared reputation.
Love reaching the heart shows public speech assigning an unseen inward cause to the observed scandal.
Public currency and renown make the circulating account consequential enough to provoke a response.
Her later first-person admission confirms the focus verb while preserving the contest of wills within it.

structural_cues: 12:30 moves the affair into speech by women in the city.
12:31 says she heard their intrigue, and 12:32 stages her admission before them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public speech, a claim about inward love, her hearing, and her admission; I infer that the focus verdict becomes a reputational object that actors then manage. A live alternative is that public gossip amplifies the event and should not inherit the witness's evidentiary force.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah settles a bounded household dispute.
changed_reading.after: Its claim and test seed a circulating social narrative; later speech partly confirms the solicitation while also adding speculative motives and reputational pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The material test can make truth legible without making truth govern the outcome: after signs have been seen, a new decision emerges to confine Yusuf.

activation_trace.role: The focus mark supplies evidence capable of being recognized.
The test explicitly connects evidence to a truth classification.
The emergence of a new opinion marks an institutional decision made after evidentiary recognition.
Visible signs generalize the focus trace into acknowledged indications.
Confinement is the practical outcome despite the preceding signs.

structural_cues: 12:35 places the decision to imprison after the explicit temporal phrase that they had seen the signs.
The ayah does not state that the signs were unseen or refuted before confinement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognized signs followed by imprisonment; I infer a deliberate separation between knowing and acting on the evidence. A live alternative is that confinement manages scandal rather than formally denying Yusuf's truth, but either reading leaves evidence unable to determine the outcome.

changed_reading.before: Once the shirt test establishes the truthful party, the crisis should resolve in accordance with that knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The ayah establishes epistemic truth but not institutional justice; power can recognize the signs and still choose containment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a remote garment-specific branch within the focus word for lying. It remains anchored in the explicit shirt, tear, witness-mark, and liar construction; downstream prose should present it only as a material-semiotic echo, not as the lexical meaning of the accusation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same ayah places a garment beside a branch in which a decorated garment can misrepresent its condition, then subjects that garment to a revealing tear.

activation_trace.role: The shirt is a covering whose intact appearance can conceal the interaction that produced its damage.
A garment that misrepresents by its condition activates the possibility that surfaces can participate in deception.
The oriented slit interrupts the covering's potentially misleading surface.
The resulting mark converts the garment from possible screen into inspectable witness.

changed_reading.before: The shirt is a neutral evidence carrier.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, clothing first functions as a surface that can conceal or mislead, while its tear breaks that surface open and makes it testify.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain parallel is surprising because it links textile damage in the focus to bodily cuts later in the scene. It remains anchored in the focus's cut and witness-mark plus the packet's sight-triggered cutting of hands; downstream prose should call it a repeated inscription motif, not legal proof that the hand wounds adjudicate 12:26.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes a cut surface testify, and 12:31 repeats involuntary physical marking when sight overwhelms speech.

activation_trace.role: The longitudinal garment cut is the first physical inscription from which agency is reconstructed.
The mark-as-witness branch licenses attention to nonverbal traces.
Severing injury produces a second visible trace generated during the same desire conflict.
The bodily hand localizes the later inscription in the observers themselves.

changed_reading.before: The torn shirt is an isolated forensic clue.
changed_reading.after: The pericope repeats a pattern in which desire escapes verbal management and writes itself onto cloth or flesh, leaving marks that expose more than speakers intend.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a deliberately form-distant activation from the packet's split mapping for the focus speech root. It remains anchored in Yusuf's opening utterance and its immediate displacement of accusation into testing; downstream prose must label it a root-split resonance, not a dictionary gloss of 'said.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yusuf's opening speech is the event that unsettles a fixed accusation and puts the account into evidentiary motion.

activation_trace.role: Instability and movement make the utterance an exploratory destabilizer of the already forming verdict.
Knowledge-based clarification is the new process opened once his speech unsettles the accusation.

changed_reading.before: He merely adds a second statement to a verbal dispute.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, his utterance is the destabilizing act that prevents her first accusation from settling and forces a change of medium from assertion to evidence.

strongest_changes: The shirt changes from a static clue into a kinematic record of pursuit, relative position, and escape.
The solicitation changes from private persuasion into coercive pressure on self-command backed by enclosure, command, prison, and humiliation.
The phrase about Yusuf's own self acquires a possible counter-history of personhood after concealment, sale, undervaluation, purchase, and assigned household identity.
The truth test proves epistemically effective but institutionally nonbinding when signs are recognized and confinement follows.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah converts an oriented tear into conditional testimony while preserving several scales at once: bodily agency, household affiliation, public reputation, material inference, and the later gap between recognized truth and exercised power.
remaining_uncertainties: The expanded self-possession reading of 'my self' is abductively supported by the prior objectification chain but may exceed the phrase's immediate idiomatic force.
Tear direction strongly reconstructs relative position and motion, but motive still depends on the narrated sequence rather than geometry alone.
The later plural signs plausibly include the shirt evidence, but the packet does not enumerate them.
The lying-garment and speech-instability readings are intentionally contained lexical outliers and should not displace the stronger forensic models.
